```{=html}
<a class="skip-link" href="#questionnaire">Skip to questionnaire</a>
<div class="app-shell">
  <header class="site-header">
    <a class="wordmark" href="./" aria-label="Chronotype lab home"><img id="tum-logo" class="tum-logo" src="assets/tum-en.png" alt="Technical University of Munich"><span class="wordmark-title">Chronotype lab<small>Sleep questionnaire</small></span></a>
    <div class="header-meta"><span class="event-name">THE STUDENT CHRONOTYPE LAB</span><span id="mode-badge" class="pill">No sign-in needed</span><div class="language-switch" aria-label="Language"><button type="button" data-language="en" aria-pressed="true">EN</button><button type="button" data-language="de" aria-pressed="false">DE</button></div></div>
  </header>
  <main id="app-main">
    <section id="questionnaire" class="questionnaire-layout" aria-label="Chronotype questionnaire">
      <aside class="intro-panel">
        <div class="eyebrow">Munich Chronotype Questionnaire</div>
        <h1>What’s your<br><em>chronotype?</em></h1>
        <p class="intro-copy">Answer a few questions about when you sleep on scheduled days and free days.</p>
        <figure class="clock-figure">
          <div id="sleep-clock" class="sleep-clock"></div>
          <figcaption><strong>A</strong> <span id="clock-caption">Sleep on a 24-hour clock</span></figcaption>
        </figure>
        <div class="intro-footer"><span>ABOUT 3 MINUTES</span><span>BASED ON THE MCTQ</span></div>
      </aside>
      <div class="form-panel">
        <nav class="step-nav" aria-label="Questionnaire progress" id="step-nav"></nav>
        <div id="form-content"></div>
        <div class="form-footnote">Use your usual sleep times from the past few weeks, in local time.</div>
      </div>
    </section>
    <section id="result" class="result-layout" hidden aria-label="Your chronotype result"></section>
  </main>
  <footer class="site-footer"><span>Munich Chronotype Questionnaire (MCTQ)</span><div><a href="methods.html">Method &amp; reference data</a><button class="text-button" id="privacy-button">Privacy</button></div></footer>
</div>
<dialog id="privacy-dialog" aria-labelledby="privacy-title">
  <button class="close-button" id="close-privacy" aria-label="Close privacy information">×</button>
  <div class="eyebrow">Questionnaire data</div><h2 id="privacy-title">Privacy</h2>
  <p>Your answers and result stay in this tab. The app does not send or save them. Read <a href="methods.html#data-and-deployment">the data notes</a> for details.</p>
</dialog>
<noscript><p class="noscript">Please enable JavaScript to complete the questionnaire. You can still read <a href="methods.html">the scoring method</a>.</p></noscript>
```
